stem: A pharmacist seeks to enter a collaborative practice agreement. Select all threshold qualifications supported by statute.

choices.text: Maintain the required Massachusetts license and professional-liability coverage.
No written agreement is needed after five years of practice.
Meet the degree-or-experience and additional annual CE requirements.
Technician registration satisfies the pharmacist-license requirement.
The supervising physician may waive statutory qualifications orally.
